NORA WELLS TO ARUN MOSS. August 21, 1847
Dear colleague,
The east depot reported receiving the canal register sent
by Arun Moss in response to the request of August 18,
1847.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.

ARUN MOSS TO NORA WELLS. August 21, 1847
Dear colleague,
In response to that request of August 18, 1847, I, Arun
Moss, sent the canal register to the east depot.
